loading.note: STARTING VALUES from field reports (secondary sources, not measured by us). Qwen3.5 dense models are multimodal checkpoints used text-only: the vision tower is frozen. Their Gated DeltaNet layers have the projections in_proj_qkv, in_proj_z, in_proj_b, in_proj_a and out_proj, so they are LoRA targets besides the attention and MLP ones; names that a model does not have (Qwen3-0.6B has no DeltaNet) are ignored. LoRA runs in BF16. Do not combine flash_attention_2 with sample packing (this pipeline does not pack: each example is its own row). First thing to check on the PC: the target modules actually found, in the training log.
